title: Ironhaven Village
description: Forge town built over its own furnace, where nothing cools down, including the people. Magda wants dragon scales, with receipts. Koss has seen past the southern gate and will only say 'streetlights'. Dr. Cog cannot tell whether you walked in or something walked you in.

steps.text: Ironhaven was built over its own furnace and never let anyone forget it. The forges ran day and night, the streets were warm in winter and unbearable in summer, and every third citizen had an opinion about efficiency that they would share whether or not you had stopped walking.

lines.speaker: Blacksmith Magda
lines.text: Travelers! Good. Hold this. ...No, put it down. You're holding it wrong.

lines.speaker: Blacksmith Magda
lines.text: Ironhaven makes the best steel in the realm. Bring me dragon scales and I'll prove it.

lines.speaker: Blacksmith Magda
lines.text: Four of them. With receipts. I was burned once by a man with a lizard.

lines.speaker: War Veteran Koss
lines.text: Don't let her rush you. Nothing in this town ever cools down, including the people.

lines.speaker: War Veteran Koss
lines.text: I fought past the southern gate, once. I won't tell you what's out there.

lines.speaker: Dr. Cog
lines.text: Fascinating. You walked in here on your own, or something walked you in. I genuinely cannot tell.

lines.speaker: Dr. Cog
lines.text: Most visitors can't either. That's the interesting part.

lines.speaker: Dr. Cog
lines.text: If you ever find out which it was, come and tell me. I have been trying to find out about myself for years.
